description: This file contains TypeScript source code defining various utility functions, types, and warning message generators for handling group policy warnings within a larger project. It provides functions to compose, project, and generate warnings related to group policy configurations, especially for open and allowlist policies, including account-specific and route-specific policies.

methods.name: export function composeWarningCollectors<Params>( composeWarningCollectors
methods.description: Creates a composite warning collector function that aggregates multiple warning collectors, filtering out null or undefined collectors.

methods.name: export function projectWarningCollector<Params, Projected>( projectWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a new warning collector by applying a projection function to the input parameters before passing to the base collector.

methods.name: export function projectConfigWarningCollector<Params extends { cfg: OpenClawConfig }>( projectConfigWarningCollector
methods.description: Wraps a warning collector to focus on parameters containing an OpenClawConfig object, projecting it accordingly.

methods.name: export function projectConfigAccountIdWarningCollector< projectConfigAccountIdWarningCollector
methods.description: Wraps a warning collector with parameters including config and optional accountId, projecting these for the inner collector.

methods.name: export function projectAccountWarningCollector< projectAccountWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a warning collector focusing on the 'account' property of the parameters.

methods.name: export function projectAccountConfigWarningCollector< projectAccountConfigWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a warning collector that projects account and a configured version of the config property.

methods.name: export function createConditionalWarningCollector<Params>( createConditionalWarningCollector
methods.description: Generates a warning collector that concatenates results from multiple collectors, skipping falsy results.

methods.name: export function composeAccountWarningCollectors< composeAccountWarningCollectors
methods.description: Combines a base account warning collector with additional conditional collectors based on the account.
